title: Pam Bondi’s Secret DOJ Email Address Revealed
title_cn: Pam Bondi’s Secret DOJ Email Address Revealed
summary:
A FOIA request has uncovered another little-known feature of life at the top of the Justice Department: attorneys general have used alternate email addresses to conduct government business for over a decade. This time around, Bloomberg News Senior Investigative Reporter Jason Leopold obtained the alias used by former Attorney General Pam Bondi.

The discovery raises broader questions about government transparency and access to public records. Leopold explains how alternate email addresses can make FOIA searches more difficult when requesters don’t know which accounts officials used to conduct government business -- and how revealing those aliases can help journalists locate records that might otherwise be missed. He speaks with Bloomberg Businessweek Daily hosts Carol Massar and Alexis Christoforous. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Chris Swonger, President and CEO of the Distilled Spirits Council of the United States, says the US represents 93% of the Canadian spirits industry and warns that restrictions on cross-border trade will hurt the hospitality economy on both sides of the border. Swonger says the spirits industry has thrived with no trade barriers and zero-to-zero tariffs, and says the sector is also facing pressure from GLP-1 medications, younger consumers drinking less and inflationary challenges. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rep. Landsman: AI Czar Wouldn’t Provide Enough Oversight
title_cn: Rep. Landsman: AI Czar Wouldn’t Provide Enough Oversight
summary: Rep. Greg Landsman (D-OH) says naming a White House AI czar would not provide the level of oversight needed around AI and data centers. Rep. Landsman says nondisclosure agreements surrounding data-center deals should be banned and says his legislation would require data centers to pay their costs rather than pass them on to individuals. Rep. Landsman says the bill would fine data centers $15 million a day for noncompliance and transfer authority over who pays to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

Rediker says he has been reluctant to think the Fed would raise rates because of the proximity to the midterm elections, though he says he is not highly confident in that view. Rediker also says bond markets in the US and France are subject to the influence of “bond vigilantes” and says he would not rule out the 10-year Treasury yield reaching 6%. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
